public_gates: M1508 must implement rollout candidate schemas and measured-distance helpers

no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1507 rollout candidate design can be implemented as no-training schemas, distance helpers, and materialization guards with focused tests.
success_criteria: rollout candidate probe implementation code exists
candidate materialization guard prevents reset-only evidence from becoming candidates
matching helpers avoid forbidden actor inputs
next public probe smoke or bounded-runner route is explicit
failure_criteria: implementation starts training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or corpus export
decision_rule: M1508 passes if it implements no-training rollout candidate scaffolding with focused tests and no corpus export or training.
